200.description: Every MCP tool with its area and what it needs

name.description: Name a client calls the tool by

area.description: The part of NPMpro the tool works on

needs.description: What a token needs: view or manage on the area's section, manage plus the token's Allow delete switch (`delete`), or the Administrator switch (`admin`)

403.description: Not allowed: the user is not an administrator, or the token lacks its Administrator switch

description:
Lists every MCP tool with the area it belongs to and what a token needs to use it, for the API access section of Settings. It lists all tools, whatever the caller's own permissions; `tools/list` of the MCP endpoint lists only what the token may use.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)
